articles.summary: Milestone celebrates employees’ commitment to supporting local communities EVERETT, Wash., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Community Bank (“coastal”, “our”, “we”, “bank”) announced that the Coastal Employee Giving Fund (the “Fund”) has surpassed $1 million in community grants, marking a significant milestone in employees’ collective commitment to giving back. The milestone reflects the power of employees coming together around a shared purpose: strengthening the communities where they live and work. Through the fund, that commitment translates into grants that help nonprofit organizations serve their communities and respond to local needs. “Reaching $1 million in community grants is a meaningful reflection of our employees’ generosity and care for their neighbors,” said Chris Adams, Executive Chair at Coastal Community Bank. “Each grant represents an opportunity to support the organizations doing essential work in our communities. articles.title: Coastal Employee Giving Fund Surpasses $1 Million in Community Grants
